beats.say: Discover how Tetris conquered the world in the 1980s.
Alexey Pajitnov created the game in the mid-1980s while working at the Academy of Sciences.
Floppy disk copies were distributed freely throughout Moscow before spreading to Eastern Europe.
Robert Stein saw Tetris in Hungary and secured a license to release it commercially.
Mirrorsoft in the UK and Spectrum HoloByte in the US released Tetris in 1988.
Henk Rogers then negotiated to license Tetris to Nintendo for the Game Boy.
Both Nintendo versions arrived in 1989 and fueled massive console success.
Rights reverted to Pajitnov at the end of 1995, and it is the best-selling game with 520 million copies as of 2022.

facts: Tetris was created by Alexey Pajitnov in the mid-1980s
Alexey Pajitnov worked at the Dorodnitsyn Computing Center of the Academy of Sciences
Floppy disk copies were distributed freely throughout Moscow before spreading to Eastern Europe
Robert Stein of Andromeda Software saw Tetris in Hungary and secured a license to release it commercially
Mirrorsoft in the UK and Spectrum HoloByte in the US released Tetris in 1988 to commercial success
Henk Rogers negotiated with Elektronorgtechnica to license Tetris to Nintendo for the Game Boy and Nintendo Entertainment System
Both Nintendo versions were released in 1989
At the end of 1995 rights to Tetris reverted to Pajitnov
Tetris is the best-selling video game of all time with 520 million copies sold as of 2022
